text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Honjamaa~, ponjamaaa~~
Today's training fortune issss~...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Mmh!? "Slow and steady wins the race"!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
I see, I see, I see!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Meaning, just like a Heian noble,
I should head toward the track while following an auspicious direction!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Now that that's settled, let's face the lucky direction and...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~!!
To think such a delightful place lay in the auspicious direction!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's definitely not because I want to goof off or do anything wicked!
Think of it more like training prep!
